race.title: Wrexham Lager Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Bumper winners POINTOFDIFFERENCE and Cool Customer ought to come to the fore here. The latter has the benefit of experience over obstacles but the former looked useful last month so is marginally preferred. Point recruit Koaly Play also needs considering. POINTOFDIFFERENCE COOL CUSTOMER (IRE) KOALY PLAY (IRE)
